stem: Which statement by a hospitalized client reflects a right protected under the federal Hospital Conditions of Participation?

options.A: I can participate in my plan of care and request or refuse treatment after receiving information about my care
options.B: I must accept every treatment recommended by the hospital
options.C: I have no right to information about my health status
options.D: I may participate in care planning only if the hospital chooses to allow it

rationale: 42 CFR 482.13 requires hospitals to protect and promote patient rights. Patients have the right to participate in development and implementation of the plan of care, make informed decisions, be informed of health status, participate in care planning and treatment, and request or refuse treatment.
educational_objective: Recognize federal hospital patient rights related to participation and informed treatment decisions.
source_organization: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services / eCFR
source_document_title: 42 CFR §482.13 — Condition of Participation: Patient's Rights
source_claim_supported: Supports patient participation in care planning, informed decisions, and the right to request or refuse treatment.
correction_summary: Focused the item on explicit federal patient-rights text instead of a generic 'patient bill of rights' list.
audit_findings: A states rights contained in §482.13; B-D contradict the regulation.
